delete.description: Remove baseline status. Does NOT invalidate previous regression verdicts.

post.description:
Pin an experiment as the baseline for its lineage.

Rules:
- Only COMPLETED experiments can be pinned
- Unpins any existing baseline with same (dataset_name, model_name) lineage
- Cannot pin an experiment that references another baseline
- pinned_attempt is frozen to current_attempt at pin time

get.description:
Basic health check.

Returns:
    Simple status indicating the server is running.
    Does NOT check dependencies.

Readiness check for dependencies.

Checks (run concurrently):
    - Database connection (NeonDB)
    - Vector database connection (Qdrant Cloud)
    - Optional server provider configuration (not credential validation)
    - Task dispatch / Upstash / RQ worker status

Returns:
    Status of each dependency.
